name: Section 122 temporary import surcharge (Proclamation 11012 of February 24, 2026)
notes: Replaces IEEPA reciprocal tariffs (struck down by Supreme Court on Feb 20, 2026).
Rate: 10% ad valorem (Proclamation 11012, February 20, 2026). Statutory ceiling under section 122 is 15%.
Exempt: all goods already subject to Section 232 tariffs (steel, aluminum, copper, autos/parts) per proclamation paragraph 14(k).
Exempt: goods covered by EXEMPTIONS_S122 (Annex I and II of Proclamation 11012).
Court of International Trade ruled Section 122 unlawful on May 7, 2026 (stayed by CAFC on May 12, 2026); tariff remains in effect as of June 2026.
Expires July 24, 2026 (150-day statutory limit) unless extended by Congress.
